{"metadata":{"description":"Tavily-backed web search for DeepSeek Harness: multi-key pool with balance-aware rotation, automatic failover, and usage stats — switchable from the DSH settings panel.","id":"gh:1376144026","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-tavily-pool","slug":"stormbuf/dsh-tavily-pool","topics":["deepseek","dsh","dsh-plugin","tavily","web-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Tavily-backed web search for DeepSeek Harness: multi-key pool with balance-aware rotation, automatic"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" failover, and usage stats — switchable from the DSH settings panel."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-tavily-pool"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Tavily-backed web search **and** page fetching for DeepSeek Harness: multi-key pool with balance-awa"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"re rotation, automatic failover, cooldown, official `/usage` balance reporting, and independent togg"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"les for search and fetch — configurable from the DSH settings panel."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Not to be confused with `SZMY-haruhi/dsh-tavily` (single key / keyless, no scheduling) or `@yuuz12"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"/dsh-tavily` (multi-key, but no fetch takeover and it rewrites internal fields at runtime). This plu"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"gin manages a **pool** of keys, schedules by remaining balance, and takes over **both** `web_search`"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ool** of keys, schedules by remaining balance, and takes over **both** `web_search` and `web_fetch`."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Multi-key pool** — add one key or paste a whole batch (one per line), label, enable/disable, reo"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"rder, remove one or several at once; the UI only ever shows masked keys
- **Scheduling policy** — sw"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"itch between balance-first ordering and plain manual order, where the list order becomes the schedul"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ing order
- **Balance-aware rotation** — highest remaining balance first; three-state balance (the l"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"imit comes from `key.limit`, falling back to the account's `account.plan_limit` — only when **both**"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" are explicitly `null` is a key unlimited and ranked first; unknown goes last)
- **Automatic failove"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"r** — a failing key hands the request to the next one
- **Cooldown** — honors upstream `Retry-After`"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"; cooled keys are hard-excluded until it expires, and when every key is cooling the request waits fo"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"r the earliest one within a bounded budget
- **Status-aware errors** — separates temporary failures,"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" permanent key death (body-inspected, never status-code-only), and quota exhaustion (`432` / `433` t"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"reated alike: the key stays out of rotation until `/usage` confirms a positive balance)
- **Official"},{"id":"p7s12","text":" balance, refreshed on use** — the card's credit figure is the official `/usage` reading (limit − us"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"ed). A reading is pulled again when the key being used has one over an hour old, when a key is added"},{"id":"p7s14","text":", and for any key still missing a reading the next time the plugin is used at all. The plugin keeps "},{"id":"p7s15","text":"**no** credit accounting of its own: Tavily's billing rules can change at any time, so a locally com"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"puted figure could silently become wrong. Between readings the ordering is nudged forward by a delib"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"erately rough per-call estimate that is never shown as a number of its own; it does move the display"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"ed `used` figure, so the card also says how old the last official reading is. Nothing runs in the ba"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"ckground: no search or fetch means no `/usage` traffic at all
- **Balance refresh** — pulls official"},{"id":"p7s20","text":" `/usage` with per-key sliding-window quota reservation, so it never trips the 10-per-10-minutes lim"},{"id":"p7s21","text":"it
- **Configurable search parameters** — search depth, result cap, topic, and generated-answer togg"},{"id":"p7s22","text":"le, all taking effect immediately
- **Fetch takeover (off by default)** — maps `web_fetch` to Tavily"},{"id":"p7s23","text":" `/extract`, returning plain text (never HTML, which DSH would convert a second time); extraction de"},{"id":"p7s24","text":"pth and output format are configurable. Turn it on in settings when you want Tavily to handle fetchi"},{"id":"p7s25","text":"ng too
- **Call history and chart** — every call is recorded (key, endpoint, outcome, duration, `req"},{"id":"p7s26","text":"uest_id`) and drawn as a 14-day call-count chart; the file is bounded by both an entry cap and a 30-"},{"id":"p7s27","text":"day window
- **Independent toggles** — search and fetch can be switched back to the official provide"},{"id":"p7s28","text":"rs separately
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — plain ESM, no build step"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> **Shipped:** the whole spec — search takeover and its toggle, the key pool (single key,
> pasted b"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"atch, bulk removal), failover with cooldown, search parameters, the scheduling
> policy, balance ref"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"resh, fetch takeover with its own toggle (off by default), call history
> with its chart, the per-ke"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"y call stats and balance bar, the connectivity test, and the
> settings card with its HTTP API."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"From the npm registry:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Or straight from GitHub, which needs no registry account. Pin a released tag when you want a
reprodu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"cible version — see the tags for
the ones that exist:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Both routes install the same files: the `files` whitelist in `package.json` applies to git installs "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"too, so no `test/` or `scripts/` directory comes along."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then restart DSH, open **Settings → Plugins → dsh-tavily-pool** and paste your Tavily API key(s). Ke"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ys are entered through the panel only — the plugin does not read environment variables or the DSH cr"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ough the panel only — the plugin does not read environment variables or the DSH credentials service."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"See `docs/usage.md` for configuration, scheduling behaviour, billing, and manual rollback steps."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness is in preview, so its architecture and plugin interfaces may change between release"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"s. This plugin isolates nearly all host-specific knowledge in one thin adapter layer (`lib/dsh/`), p"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"lus the zero-build client half (`lib/client.js`) and the provider pin in `cordis.patch.yml`, and pro"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"bes host capabilities at load time, so that adapting to a breaking change stays cheap."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Tested against DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`.** A newer release may still need re-adaptation; the plugin probes"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" host capabilities at load time and reports a clear error naming the missing one rather than failing"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" silently. Its host peer ranges carry **only a lower bound**, so an untested DSH release never refus"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"es to load the plugin — DSH 0.1.7 added a hard gate that skips a whole bundle whose peer range exclu"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"des the running version, which turns a stale upper bound into a silently missing plugin. The step-by"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"-step checklist lives in `docs/dsh-upgrade.md`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Installing through `dsh plugin add` makes this package a **bundle layer** of the target profile (it "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"lands in that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, after the DSH bundles), which is what lets its `cordi"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"s.patch.yml` pin the providers. Your own profile patch is applied after every bundle layer, so it ca"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"n always override or disable what this plugin does — see Manual rollback."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
